pristine.sourcePolicy: byte-exact pinned upstream package source compiled with React types

adapted.sourcePolicy: one-for-one adapted adapter source after permitted transformations

permittedTransformations.rule: devtools.tsx becomes devtools.tsrx; the Octane declaration companion remains outside the one-for-one inventory
React JSX/hooks/portal imports become Octane equivalents; createPortal becomes DevtoolsPortal

divergences.rule: Public adapter types keep framework-prefixed names on each side
Octane index.ts additionally re-exports framework-neutral @tanstack/devtools values and types
